The accidental duplicate mapping was NOT carried over; the clone's copy process normalizes/dedupes to one row per test case (at least for a null-configuration case), even though test_case_selection defaulted to 'all'. This is the single most informative finding of this probe: clone_test_run_v2 is not a byte-for-byte structural copy of the source's row table — it re-derives the case list, deduping what add_test_cases had duplicated.

SYNCHRONOUS: response was 200 (not 202) — no build_pending flag, so per the capability's own guidance this codepath completed identity AND case-mapping synchronously in this instance (unlike a sibling capability's 202 in this batch). This is a genuine 200-that-actually-worked, unlike the two capabilities flagged upstream in this batch whose 200/202 changed nothing — confirmed by real before/after storage reads, not by trusting the response body alone.

NUMERIC ID: neither the create response nor the clone's own get_test_run_v2-shape body exposes any numeric id or uuid for TR-9063 — only the TR-NNN string identifier.
